notes.title: Fresh Weiner Update
notes.content:
Hotdog Stand

Now own a business even sooner! Buy your very own hotdog stand right at Yum Cola Park and start swimming in those fish bucks.


 Buy the hotdog stand for $5000.00. It is much cheaper than the other businesses, helping you gain money faster.
 Sell the stand at the bank when you are done with the weiner business.
 The hotdog stand comes with an employee to take care of business and free up your time for other things.
 Keep the hotdog maker filled with cooked meat, open shop and your employee will take care of the rest.
 Use the phone to call a meat vendor for easy access to cooked meat or place a stove to cook your own meat.
 Provides a small area for placing furniture.


Gas Station

Improvements to the gas station business


 You can now hire an employee.
 The employee costs you 2% of sales.
 hiring the employee will allow you to leave the gas station property while the gas station is open.
 You will still need to keep the shelves full.
 Increased the amount customers will pay for items slightly.
 Increased the minimum amount of gas customers who drive in will get from 3$ to 20$


New Item

A new oversized parts shelf can be purchased at Grandma Sandy's Storage. Vehicle parts will not take damage when stored on the shelf. Organize and safely store your parts like never before.

Change


 Changed the reward for finishing the Lordfish mansion.
 Take less fall damage.


Fix


 Gas Staion costs $45000.00 but was listed as $90000.00
 Factory sold for half as much as it cost.

notes.title: Changes
notes.content:
Changes


 All houses and businesses are half the original price except the campground which is quater price
 Increased the price tomato, carrot and canned goods sell for to the farm stand
 Weapons at Tylers are cheaper
 The battering ram is unlocked at Tylers at the same time as all other weapons
 You no longer need to buy 3 weapons from Tyler to progress the story
 You no longer need to retrieve the weapon from the top of the tower for Tyler to progress the story


Fix


 Opening a door with a weapon from Tyler provides an item (eg. breaking a rusty door with a rusty pipe). Items will now continue to spawn in the area where the door was every 2 - 9 mins 
 Fixed an issue when talking to Tyler the cursor disappeared
 Lordfish key is easier to interact with

notes.title: Fix
notes.content:

 The rent sign at the starter house appears in front of the house after you are kicked out

notes.title: Quality Of Life
notes.content:
Changes


 Vehicle parts can no long be damaged beyond repair. Every part can always be repaired.
 House and vehicle paint does not run out. Paints can be recycled at any point.
 When attaching parts the progess bar will be green and when removing parts the progress bar will be red.
 Replaced the building for the parts store. Parts pickup area is now inside the building.
 Replaced many signs around town.
 Changed tiny pink truck that can be cut into scrap to a rusty vehicle frame.
 Jump slightly higher.
 Sober up faster when drunk.
 Greater chance of finding vehicles around town.
 Basic vehicle parts are dropped around town initially quicker with slightly more time between spawns.


Fix


 Meat man menu closes when you walk away.
 Van rear axle was named coupe rear axle.
 Custom paint would come out black if you did not left click the color before purchase. Will now always provide the color that the purchase button is.

notes.title: Fishton Easter Event
notes.content:
Hunt For Holiday Loot All Over Fishton

Holiday fun is back in Fishton to accompany the 90% off sale! Find your favorite new decoration to celebrate Easter and liven up your home.

Every 4 minutes a new Easter egg will appear somewhere in Fishton. Easter eggs are big and easy to spot but the town is full of places to explore so keep your eyes open. Open as many eggs as you can to find snacks and Easter decorations. Easter decorations can be placed on property you own or sold at the pawn shop for a higher value than average furniture.
Let the hunt begin!

Fix

 Tooltip on the washer and dryer at the laundromat displays sooner
 Can add items to inventory with the E key
 The map displayed the forest map after towing a car to the arcade
 Fixed the tooltip on garbage bags for Cool Andy
 Fixed the tooltip on trailers when in a vehicle

notes.title: Not Dead Yet
notes.content:
After some time to reflect on the changes that have come to Fishton with all the content added with weekly updates we have updated our store page with a new trailer and description that shows what Fishton has become. Thank you so much to our wonderful community for all the engagement and feedback that helped shaped Fishton into the adventure it is today.

Changes


 People drop parts around town more frequently.
 Simplified Bro-Dog interactions in the storyline


Fix


 1 reward during the storyline was not complete
 The timer for the cafe job would stay on screen unless you left the cafe
 Failing to finish the race before time ran out casued an error
 Fixed 1 interaction with Tyler

notes.title: Fix

Fix for storage box and tool box loading in 3x it's original size when attached to a vehicle.

notes.title: Halloween Fun Event
notes.content:
Yum Cola Presents Halloween Fun Fair 2024!

Come celebrate 2 years of Fishton with us at the Yum Cola Park with fun games and prizes to be won. Play games to collect Pumpkin Tokens and other prizes. Trade your Tokens in at Pumpkin Jacks Token Exchange to bring home your favorite prizes.
Hurry to get your new items, the fair packs up on Nov 7th.
Unlike past events, Items obtained from this event will not be available for purchase from Scavanger Joe.
Speaking of Scavanger Joe, If you see him around town stop by to pick up a Halloween Hat for Kit-10 from our past event.

notes.content:
Campground

 Visit Lordfish to sell the campground back to him for $40000.
 Change your mind? Visit him again to buy it back.
 Selling will also pay out any outstanding profit.
 Selling will pay Lordfish any money you owe him.


Item Spawns

 Sports Car parts at Lordfish Mansion spawn more often. If needed for the story, each location has a max of 5 parts. When not needed each location has a max of 3. These areas will be cleared on exit.

notes.title: Mechanic Mania Update
notes.content:
A New Business
Get yourself a functional factory today!

 Manufacture two vehicle bodies not obtainable previously.
 Manufacture vehicle parts.
 New welding mechanics.
 Unlocks new tow location.
 Purchasing unlocks new item spawns at the tent camping ground.
 Only available for purchase after opening the gate to the forest.


Two New Vehicles
The Euro Sports Car and the Heavy Truck feature higher than average top speeds and selling price. Both are only available after purchasing the new factory. 

Replaceable Wheels

 Wheels can now be removed and replaced on all vehicles.
 Wheels can only be added to axles.
 Wheels only fit the corresponding vehicle.
 Wheels have been added to loot spawns.
 Sports Car Wheels can be found at the Lord Fish Mansion only after completing that part of the storyline.
 Tims Tires sells wheels for Coupe, Hatchback, Sedan, Truck, Van and SUV.
 Tim will only replace your wheels if the vehicle has a front and rear axle.


Engine Changes
Each engine has different horsepower.

New Opponents
No more easy races, new opponents pose more of a challenge.
Added many new opponents with varying degrees of difficulty.

Fishmas has ended

notes.title: Fishmas - Week 4

New Fishmas gifts
This week features Fishmas greetings from the event winners and so much more!

Scavenger Joe collects rare items from around town and sells them for a massive profit.
He sets up around town, moving often to avoid suspicion. His scavenging methods are not always so legal. 
In celebration of Fishmas he has a free gift for Kit-10. Find him this week only to claim yours!

notes.title: Fishmas
notes.content:
Fishmas Event
Santa has crash landed at the park in Fishton. He is going to need your help to save christmas. It seems our favorite Fishton protagonist may be behind this and Santa has had enough. It may be all up to you. will you save christmas?

 Talk to Santa in the Out of Towners bar to begin the event.
 Santa will give you a box of decorations.
 Take the decorations to the park and grab yourself a christmas tree.
 Return all of the reindeer to Santas sleigh.
 Talk to Santa again to claim your reward.
 After Santa has his sleigh back he will bring presents to your decorated tree and your stocking every hour that your are on. Reloading the game restarts the countdown for gifts.

Each weekly update for the month of December will bring new gifts from Santa.

notes.content:
Introducing Kit 10

Big changes have come to Fishton with introductions to Kit 10 and Rusty the NPC.
To celebrate, all bars in town now include Kit 10's Wild slot machines.

Kit 10
Kit 10 is a loveable robo-cat companion. If you find Kit 10 and fix it up it will be your loyal friend through the good times and the bad. Kit 10 will follow your every command and even bring you gifts to show his gratitude!

Rusty
You know ol' Rusty. He's always driving around town in that old rusty hunk of junk with the loose tire. Why don't you do yourselves both a favor and grind it up for scrap.
